sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Link previews on MusicBrainz: edit and editor cards (org/iframe.org Phase 3), read from the pages themselves since the Web Service has neither. An edit's card shows its number and type, status, vote tally, editor, when it opened and closed (or how long voting runs) and its first changes; its window adds every change, the entities it touches and its notes. MusicBrainz shows an edit's editor and notes only to editors who are logged in; a logged-out card says so. An editor's card shows the user type, member since, edit counts (total, accepted, auto-edits, voted down, open) and subscribers — never the age, gender, location, languages or bio a profile may show. An open edit is re-read on every page load (its votes change); a closed edit and a profile are kept like the other cards. Hovering a card and then opening Live page reads the page once.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine: one loader, _mbLoad(), behind _mbWsLoad() (Web Service) and the new _mbPageLoad() (a MusicBrainz page through _dpGetRaw() and the one rate gate, parsed into a record; _MB_POP_PAGE_VERSION). A page that is not the one expected (a login page) is a failure and is dropped from the Live page memory, so the next try asks again. An editor link's avatar no longer counts as artwork, which had kept every real editor link without a card.
